# Smoothcraft image requests, tier 2: blocks

1177 block textures. The rules in [image-requests.md](image-requests.md)
apply to every one: Photoreal, finely detailed base-colour (albedo) map. Flat, even, shadowless lighting: no baked shadows, ambient occlusion, highlights or reflections (Smoothcraft lights every surface itself). Keep the vanilla colours and overall read so the game is still recognisable. Block textures tile seamlessly, 16x the vanilla
size. File: `smoothcraft/mod/src/main/resources/resourcepacks/hd/assets/minecraft/textures/<texture>.png`.
